chapters.title: Vidyeshvara Samhita — The Glory of Shiva

verses.sanskrit:
ॐ नमः शिवाय शान्ताय कारणत्रयहेतवे ।
निवेदयामि चात्मानं त्वं गतिः परमेश्वर ॥
verses.translation: Om! Salutations to Shiva, the peaceful one, the cause of the three causes. I surrender my soul to You — You are the ultimate refuge, O Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit:
शिवं शान्तमजं ध्यायेत् पञ्चवक्त्रं त्रिलोचनम् ।
दशभुजं त्रिशूलेशं नीलकण्ठं सदाशिवम् ॥
verses.translation: One should meditate upon Shiva, the peaceful, the unborn, five-faced, three-eyed, ten-armed, wielder of the trident, with a blue throat — Sadashiva.

verses.sanskrit:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
महादेवो महात्मा च शिवः शम्भुर्महेश्वरः ॥
verses.translation: The Lord resides in the heart of all beings. Mahadeva, the great soul, Shiva, Shambhu, Maheshvara — He is the Supreme.

verses.sanskrit:
शिवो दाता शिवो भोक्ता शिवः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
शिवः सर्वत्र सर्वेषां शिवं शिवकरं सदा ॥
verses.translation: Shiva is the giver, Shiva is the enjoyer, Shiva is this entire universe. Shiva is everywhere and in everyone — He is ever auspicious, always bestowing blessings.

chapters.title: Rudra Samhita — The Story of Rudra

verses.sanskrit:
नमस्ते रुद्रमन्यव उतो त इषवे नमः ।
नमस्ते अस्तु धन्वने बाहुभ्यामुत ते नमः ॥
verses.translation: Salutations to You, O Rudra, and to Your anger. Salutations to Your arrows. Salutations to Your bow, and to Your arms.

verses.sanskrit:
त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥
verses.translation: We worship the three-eyed Lord Shiva, who is fragrant and who nourishes all beings. May He liberate us from death as a cucumber is severed from its vine; may He not withhold immortality.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम् ।
सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि ॥
verses.translation: I bow to the one who is white as camphor, the incarnation of compassion, the essence of worldly existence, who wears the king of serpents as a garland, and who always dwells in the lotus of the heart — Lord Shiva along with Bhavani.

verses.sanskrit:
शिवं शिवकरं शान्तं शिवात्मानं शिवोत्तमम् ।
शिवमार्गप्रणयिनं प्रणतोऽस्मि सदाशिवम् ॥
verses.translation: I bow to Sadashiva, who is auspicious, who creates auspiciousness, who is peaceful, whose nature is auspiciousness itself, who is the highest auspiciousness, who shows the path to auspiciousness.

verses.sanskrit:
शिवाय गौरीवदनाब्जबृन्दसूर्याय दक्षाध्वरनाशकाय ।
श्रीनीलकण्ठाय वृषध्वजाय तस्मै शि काराय नमः शिवाय ॥
verses.translation: To Shiva, who is the sun to the lotus of Gauri's face, the destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice, Sri Nilakantha with the bull banner — to that auspicious letter 'Shi', I bow to Shiva.

chapters.title: Kotirudra Samhita — The Ten Million Rudras

verses.sanskrit:
महादेव महात्मन् सर्वभूतमहेश्वर ।
मत्प्रसादात्परं ज्ञानं मोक्षोऽपि सुलभो भवेत् ॥
verses.translation: O Mahadeva, great soul, Lord of all beings — by My grace, supreme knowledge and even liberation become easily attainable.

verses.sanskrit:
लिङ्गमध्ये सदा तिष्ठेत् परमात्मा सनातनः ।
लिङ्गपूजा परा पूजा ज्योतिस्वरूपे नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.translation: The eternal Supreme Soul forever resides within the Lingam. Worship of the Lingam is the highest worship — salutations to You, O form of divine light.
